title: SRD: Barbarian Unarmored Defense feature swallowed — table row interleaves numeric columns into wrapped feature cell
description:
Discovered during eshyra-7tc. After eshyra-7tc recovered 13 of 14 Barbarian base-class features, the 14th — feature:barbarian:unarmored-defense (1st level) — is still missing from the generated pack. Its body heading 'Unarmored Defense' (h=13.92) is swallowed into feature:barbarian:rage's body instead of becoming its own record.

Root cause (separate from eshyra-7tc's slice-boundary fix): the SRD 5.1 Barbarian progression table's 1st-level row is extracted with the Rages/Rage Damage numeric columns interleaved BETWEEN the wrapped feature-cell words. Extracted lines:
  '1st +2 Rage, 2 +2'   (PROGRESSION_ROW; '2 +2' are the Rages=2, Rage Damage=+2 columns)
  'Unarmored'           (wrapped continuation of the Features cell)
  'Defense'
stitchProgressionRows() appends the continuation AFTER the numeric columns, yielding the row 'Rage, 2 +2 Unarmored Defense'. progressionFeaturesFromLine() strips only TRAILING numeric table cells (anchored at end), so the mid-cell '2 +2' survives and splitFeatureCell() returns ['Rage', '2 +2 Unarmored Defense']. The anchor key normalizes to '2 +2 unarmored defense', so the body 'Unarmored Defense' heading matches no anchor, has no level lead-in, and is swallowed into Rage.

This is a table-extraction/stitching root cause with broad blast radius (any class table whose feature cell wraps after interleaved numeric columns), held out of eshyra-7tc per docs/importer-fix-protocol.md hard-stop.

Expected behavior: emit feature:barbarian:unarmored-defense at level 1, and stop Rage's body at the 'Unarmored Defense' heading (Rage body should end at '...you can rage again.').

Likely files:
- packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/parseFeatures.ts (stitchProgressionRows / progressionFeaturesFromLine / splitFeatureCell — strip interior numeric-column runs from a wrapped continuation segment without corrupting legitimate names).
- test/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/parseFeatures.test.ts (add a fixture reproducing the interleaved-column wrap: '1st +2 Rage, 2 +2' / 'Unarmored' / 'Defense').
- test/srdGeneratedPack.test.ts (bump feature 182 -> 183; add unarmored-defense to the class:barbarian projection; remove the 'Unarmored Defense intentionally absent' note).

Importer safety: follow docs/importer-fix-protocol.md. Verify against SRD source; regenerate + verify:dnd5e-srd-pack.
close_reason: Fixed in PR #182: stitchProgressionRows strips the Barbarian table's trailing Rages/Rage Damage numeric columns before joining wrapped continuations, so feature:barbarian:unarmored-defense (1) emits and Rage no longer swallows it. Full 14-feature SRD Barbarian set now generated.
